2607.09316.title: Automatic Thematic Indexing of Large Literary Corpora: A Machine Learning Approach to Voltaire's Complete Works
2607.09316.paper_summary: Thematic indexing -- the practice of assigning structured conceptual labels to sections of text -- is essential to scholarly access in large-scale literary and historical editions, yet it remains a largely manual, labour-intensive process. This paper explores the application of machine learning to automatic thematic indexing, using two substantial sub-corpora of the Complete Works of Voltaire as a test case: the Essai sur les mœurs et l'esprit des nations and the Questions sur l'Encyclopédie. The task is framed as a multi-label classification problem, in which a model must assign the set of index entries that a professional indexer would apply to a given page of text. We compare a range of approaches -- from encoder-based models with classification heads to generative large language models (LLMs) fine-tuned via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) -- spanning model sizes from approximately 3 to 120 billion parameters. Our best-performing model, from the Mistral family in a 4-bit quantised configuration, achieves F1 scores of up to 0.67; we argue that these figures represent lower bounds, given the inherent subjectivity of professional indexing and the frequency with which model predictions prove semantically valid despite diverging from the print index. We further evaluate cross-corpus generalisation and conduct a detailed qualitative analysis of model behaviour on literary and rhetorical features of the source texts that prove particularly resistant to automated treatment. Our findings have implications for the broader challenge of providing structured thematic access to large-scale literary and historical corpora.
2607.09316.paper_summary_zh: 主題索引——將結構化概念標籤分配給文本段落的做法——對於大型文學和歷史版本的學術訪問至關重要，然而它仍然是一個主要依賴人工和勞動密集的過程。本文探討了機器學習在自動主題索引中的應用，以《伏爾泰全集》的兩個重要子語料庫作為測試案例： 《國民的風俗與精神隨筆》和《百科全書問題》。這項任務被框定為多標籤分類問題，其中模型必須為給定的文本頁面分配專業索引者會應用的索引條目集。我們比較了一系列方法——從帶有分類頭的編碼器模型到通過低秩適應（LoRA）微調的生成大型語言模型（LLMs）——涵蓋了從約30億到1200億參數的模型大小。我們表現最佳的模型來自Mistral系列，採用4位量化配置，達到高達0.67的F1分數；我們認為這些數字代表了下限，考慮到專業索引的固有主觀性以及模型預測儘管與印刷索引有所不同但仍然在語義上有效的頻率。我們進一步評估了跨語料庫的泛化能力，並對模型在來源文本的文學和修辭特徵上的行為進行了詳細的定性分析，這些特徵對自動處理特別具有抵抗力。我們的發現對於提供大型文學和歷史語料庫的結構化主題訪問的更廣泛挑戰具有重要意義。
